references.text: This is the original instruction that God gave to Moses regarding making golden bells and pomegranates on the robe. Exodus 39:25 describes the fulfillment of this command.
Explains the purpose of the bells: that the sound may be heard when Aaron enters the sanctuary before the Lord's presence, so that he does not die.
The preceding verse describing how they made the pomegranates from blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with the bells placed between them.
The following verse summarizing the pattern of alternating bell and pomegranate around the entire edge of the robe.
The command concerning bells and pomegranates (28:34) is here carried out exactly as prescribed.
The direct instruction (28:33) that is fulfilled in the source verse; showing complete obedience to God's detailed command.
